ayahs.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
ayahs.tr: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
ayahs.tl: Iqtarabatis Saa'atu wsan shaqqal qamar

ayahs.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
ayahs.tr: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
ayahs.tl: Wa iny yaraw aayatany yu'ridoo wa yaqooloo sihrum mustamirr

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
ayahs.tr: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
ayahs.tl: Wa kazzaboo wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum; wa kullu amrim mustaqirr

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
ayahs.tr: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad jaaa'ahum minal ambaaa'i maa feehi muzdajar

ayahs.ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.tr: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
ayahs.tl: Hikmatum baalighatun famaa tughnin nuzur

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
ayahs.tr: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
ayahs.tl: Fatawalla 'anhum; yawma yad'ud daa'i ilaa shai 'in nukur

ayahs.ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
ayahs.tr: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
ayahs.tl: khushsha'an absaaruhum yakrujoona minal ajdaasi ka annahum jaraadum muntashir

ayahs.ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
ayahs.tr: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
ayahs.tl: Muhti'eena ilad daa'i yaqoolul kafiroona haazaa yawmun 'asir

ayahs.ar: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
ayahs.tr: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohin fakazzaboo 'abdanaa wa qaaloo majnoo nunw wazdujir

ayahs.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
ayahs.tr: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
ayahs.tl: Fada'aa Rabbahooo annee maghloobun fantasir

ayahs.ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
ayahs.tl: Fafatahnaaa abwaabas sa maaa'i bimaa'im munhamir

ayahs.ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
ayahs.tr: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
ayahs.tl: Wa fajjamal arda 'uyoonan faltaqal maaa'u 'alaaa amrin qad qudir

ayahs.ar: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
ayahs.tl: Wa hamalnaahu 'alaa zaati alwaahinw wa dusur

ayahs.ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.tr: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
ayahs.tl: Tajree bi a'yuninaa jazaaa 'al liman kaana kufir

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.tl: Wa laqat taraknaahaad aayatan fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tr: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.tl: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mimmuddakir

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tr: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat 'Aadun fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
ayahs.tl: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran fee Yawmi nahsim mustamirr

ayahs.ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
ayahs.tl: Tanzi;un naasa ka anna huma'jaazu nakhlim munqa'ir

ayahs.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tr: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.tl: 'Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.tr: Thamud denied the warning
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat Samoodu binnuzur

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.tr: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
ayahs.tl: Faqaalooo a-basharam minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhooo innaa izal lafee dalaalinw wa su'ur

ayahs.ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
ayahs.tr: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
ayahs.tl: 'A-ulqiyaz zikru 'alaihi mim baininaa bal huwa kazzaabun ashir

ayahs.ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
ayahs.tr: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
ayahs.tl: Sa-ya'lamoona ghadam manil kazzaabul ashir

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
ayahs.tl: Innaa mursilun naaqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum wastabir

ayahs.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
ayahs.tr: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
ayahs.tl: Wa nabbi'hum annal maaa'a qismatum bainahum kullu shirbim muhtadar

ayahs.ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.tr: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
ayahs.tl: Fanaadaw saahibahum fata'aataa fa'aqar

ayahs.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tr: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.tl: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
ayahs.tl: Innaaa arsalnaa 'alaihim saihatanw waahidatan fakaano kahasheemil muhtazir

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad yassarnal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.tr: The people of Lot denied the warning.
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat qawmu lootim binnuzur

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
ayahs.tl: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim haasiban illaaa aala Loot najjainaahum bisahar

ayahs.ar: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
ayahs.tr: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
ayahs.tl: Ni'matam min 'indinaa; kazaalika najzee man shakar

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.tr: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad anzarahum batshatanaa fatamaaraw binnuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tr: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad raawadoohu 'andaifee fatamasnaaa a'yunahum fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
ayahs.tr: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad sabbahahum bukratan 'azaabum mustaqirr

ayahs.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tr: So taste My punishment and warning.
ayahs.tl: Fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad yassarnal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.tr: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad jaaa'a Aala Fir'awnan nuzur

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.tr: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.tl: Kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa kullihaa fa akhaznaahum akhza 'azeezim muqtadir

ayahs.ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.tr: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
ayahs.tl: Akuffaarukum khairum min ulaaa'ikum am lakum baraaa'atun fiz Zubur

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
ayahs.tr: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
ayahs.tl: Am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'um muntasir

ayahs.ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
ayahs.tr: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
ayahs.tl: Sa yuhzamul jam'u wa yuwalloonad dubur

ayahs.ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.tr: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
ayahs.tl: Balis Saa'atu maw'iduhum was Saa'atu adhaa wa amarr

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
ayahs.tl: Innal mujrimeena fee dalaalinw wa su'ur

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.tr: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
ayahs.tl: Yawma yushaboona fin Naari'alaa wujoohimim zooqoo massa saqar

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
ayahs.tl: Innaa kulla shai'in khalaqnaahu biqadar

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
ayahs.tr: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa amrunaaa illaa waahidatun kalamhim bilbasar

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad ahlaknaaa ashyaa'akum fahal mim muddakir

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.tr: And everything they did is in written records.
ayahs.tl: Wa kullu shai'in fa'aloohu fiz Zubur

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
ayahs.tr: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
ayahs.tl: Wa kullu sagheerinw wa kabeerim mustatar

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
ayahs.tl: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa nahar

ayahs.ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
ayahs.tr: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.tl: Fee maq'adi sidqin 'inda Maleekim Muqtadir
